# GrowthTechSys

> GrowthTechSys is a specialized engineering firm and digital product studio building custom AI systems, workflow automation pipelines, and enterprise field sales telematics software.

## Core Products & Platforms

- [Field Sales Automation & GPS Workforce Tracking Software](https://growthtechsys.com/product/field-sales-tracking): Turnkey, zero-hardware field sales telemetry platform with anti-mock GPS beat plan tracking, geofenced selfie attendance, mobile retail order booking with offline SQLite sync, and automated road-distance travel expense calculation.

## Core Engineering Services

- [AI Automation & Custom Agents](https://growthtechsys.com/services/ai-automation): Autonomous LLM workflows, custom multi-agent architectures, RAG pipelines, intelligent document parsing, and enterprise webhook integrations.
- [Custom Software Development](https://growthtechsys.com/services/custom-software): Production-grade web, mobile, and distributed backend architectures with microservices, high-throughput APIs, and strict data security.
- [Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps](https://growthtechsys.com/services/cloud-infrastructure): Cloud-native deployments, Kubernetes container orchestration, zero-downtime CI/CD pipelines, and multi-region infrastructure.
- [Digital Product Studio](https://growthtechsys.com/services/product-development): Zero-to-one product design, modern web applications, conversion-engineered digital platforms, and technical architecture.

## Analysis & Field Notes

- [Why Spreadsheets and WhatsApp Groups Fail Field Sales Teams](https://growthtechsys.com/blog/why-spreadsheets-whatsapp-fail-field-sales-teams): Architectural breakdown of operational profit leakages in FMCG and distribution networks, and the technical mechanisms of modern field sales telematics.
- [All Playbooks & Notes](https://growthtechsys.com/blog): Technical essays and architecture breakdowns on AI automation and digital growth systems.
